sn48.59:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni anuppannāni uppajjanti nāññatra Tathāgatassa pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassa || || Katamāni pañca || || Saddhindriyaṃ viriyindriyaṃ satindriyaṃ samādhindriyam paññindriyaṃ || || Imāni kho bhikkhave pañcindriyani bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni anuppannāni uppajjanti nāññatra Tathāgatassa pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassāti || || 1--2. Sāvatthi || ||
